title: dashboard status: one call for panes, cards, PRs and CI
notes: Retro 2026-11-26: the dashboard main session made about 250 status calls rebuilding its state (112 pane list, 69 board list, 48 gh pr list; pane list together with gh pr list 22 times), most after its 9 compactions. Add one command (and MCP tool) printing each worker pane with its card, branch, PR, CI state and the end of its last report, plus open PRs no pane holds. Keep it short enough to call after every compaction.

comments.body: Overlap check: #378 (pane run --worktree) edits src/main/workers/session-requests.ts in run()/SessionPorts.makeWorktree; this card adds a verb beside list()/report() there (file at 575 lines, so the status logic goes in a new module, only wiring in session-requests.ts). #380 (pr wait/create) edits src/main/command/mcp-tools.ts COMMAND_ONLY; this card adds one DASHBOARD_TOOLS row. Different hunks, no shared lines expected.
Pull request #383 opened: pane status: panes, cards, PRs and CI in one call https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/383

Review loop on #383: floor-addressed after 2 rounds. Round 1 fixed 9 findings in 315bdb73: pr unknown when the forge fails, report always the last column, passed CI for a pull request waiting on a review, pane status crosses builds, entryForPane moved to worktree-store, plus nits. Round 2 fixed 2 in d37e1eb1 and b19132aa: workers-decision-4 names pane status, README passed wording. Final check accepted both. Nothing rejected, nothing waiting on a person, and the card's scope and design are unchanged. Not ready to merge: CI did not run because pr wait stopped on a conflict. GitHub reports head b19132aa as CONFLICTING (DIRTY) against main 2dfbb3ae, while git merge-tree of the same two commits is clean and names no files. Next: merge origin/main into the branch and push. That clears GitHub's state and starts CI.

Converged, ready to merge. Merged origin/main (with #380, d6cbc2a3) into the branch with no conflicts and pushed it as a2c76670. Local pnpm check passed (4035 tests, typecheck, lint), and CI checks passed on a2c76670.
Pull request #383 merged: pane status: panes, cards, PRs and CI in one call https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/383
